text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon and I are heading back home when she pipes up with a question.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, do you recall our last attempt to create a "precious" memory?
choice_data_list: Oh, you mean that game of tag?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. That operation was unsuccessful. The only thing we seemed to accumulate was your fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next time, I would like you to instruct me on how to make memories, if possible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The number of methods I can simulate is limited. I have determined that I will be unable to provide worthwhile suggestions.
I was already planning to makes some suggestions, but…
Come to think of it, Mihono Bourbon has a knack for breaking machines just by touching them.
If we can overcome that issue together, maybe it will become a precious memory for her.
choice_data_list: How about we try some special training that will help you to use machines?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Will learning to use machines result in a "precious" memory?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I am still unable to comprehend what makes a memory "precious," but I am willing to go along with your suggestions.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I look forward to making memories with you.
A few days later, we start Mihono Bourbon's special training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: An electric kettle that can only bring water to a lukewarm temperature, a cracked monitor, an electric fan that only spins slowly…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Master. If it's an item that's going to be thrown away, I can touch it without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: An objective has been created—touch machines without breaking them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now… Commencing operation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: First, the electric kettle…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Serious damage detected. Complete breakdown of device confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next, the monitor…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Serious damage detected. Complete breakdown of device confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The electric fan…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Serious damage detected. Complete breakdown of device confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Calculator. Blender. Video game console…
One after the other, they all seemingly break the moment she turns them on.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The last one… A smartphone…
I gulp as soon as I realize what device she's reaching for.
It's my work phone! I carelessly left it lying near the machines we're using for this special training!
It's my work phone! I carelessly left it lying near the machines we're using for this special training!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have determined that this smartphone is your personal device. Suspending training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There are no more devices to test. Is training over?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Unfortunately.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I can see that you're disappointed. According to my analysis, it's a logical reaction.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's nothing… Just, there's something on your cheek.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you got some dust on your face while cleaning up all the broken devices.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All machines have been destroyed. I have failed our objective of safely handling them…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But, after observing your actions, I detected some useful information in my memory logs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I believe next time will be a success.
Saying nothing more, Mihono Bourbon wipes my cheek clean.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order acknowledged. Proceeding with cau—oh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is this smartphone your personal device?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My apologies. I realized too late and touched it with my fingertips. May I ask you to confirm whether it remains operable?
I gently pick up the phone. I'm sure I left it on earlier, but now the screen is black.
Looks like it won't turn on anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I've determined that this situation will disrupt your work. We must have it repaired at once.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm truly sorry about this.
I try to comfort her by saying that I had the chance to stop her if I wanted, but she simply stares at me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's nothing… Just, there's something on your cheek.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you got some dust on your face while cleaning up all the broken devices.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All machines have been destroyed. I have failed our objective of safely handling them…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But, after observing your actions, I detected some useful information in my memory logs.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I believe next time will be a success.
Saying nothing more, Mihono Bourbon wipes my cheek clean.
